title: 第六章 高考
content_zh:
呼唤推荐票、
高考前的一个月，罗峰几乎所有精力都投入到复习当中去。随着复习的进行，以及一次次模拟试卷的测试，对高考的信心，罗峰是越来越足！
“考江南第一军校，十拿九稳。”
这就是罗峰心中想法。
※※※※※※
六月七号，这是高考第一天。华夏国的高考时间为六月七**号三天，跟大涅盘时期之前的高考日子一样。
宜安区第一高中。
按照考场安排，本是三中学生的罗峰，高考就是在这第一高中进行。
“女儿，加油。”
“放心吧，老爸。”
“甜甜，别给自己太大压力啊。”
第一高中校门外，聚集了密密麻麻大量的高考考生和家长，而在第一高中的校门口外，也站着一排手持真枪实弹的警察。
“小峰啊，考试的时候心态要放松。咱们家就算上不了第一军校，上第二军校也行的。轻松点！”父亲罗洪国看着自己儿子，笑呵呵说道。
“嗯。”罗峰笑着点头。
“滴――滴――”随着响亮的车鸣声，只见一辆全身幽黑，充满着贵族气质的最新款的奔驰s600，在一辆辆警用机车的护拥下缓缓驶向第一高中的大门，周围的考生家长立即朝旁边避让，一个个目光都聚集在那辆车上。
最新款奔驰s600，加速到时速一百，只需要一秒六，极限速度达到时速500公里。当然这点性能不算什么，奔驰s600作为从大涅盘时期就传下来的品牌，其本身的历史底蕴才是最吸引人的。
只见奔驰s600走下来三人，彼此谈笑着朝校门口走去。
“左边的秃头，就是咱们宜安区的警察局张局长啊。”
“右边的那个，是教育局的刘主任吧。”
“中间的，那一定是负责考场安全总指挥的武者。”只见考场外大量家长、考生们议论纷纷，绝大多数人目光都聚集在那中央一人身上，目光中蕴含着兴奋、崇拜、好奇。

现如今人类和怪兽的战斗，是一直在持续的。
而普通人是禁止离开市区边界的，而武者们，就是能够一对一和怪兽厮杀的存在。整个人类社会对于武者们，也是非常感激的，感激他们为人类作出那么大的贡献。普通人们自然一个个很崇拜武者。
武者，属于人类群体中地位超然的一群人。
“那就是武者啊。”父亲罗洪国也看着那人，“每次高考的考场安全总指挥，都是请武者担当。”
“武者。”
罗峰看过去，那名武者有一种让人看了就心悸的感觉，他的眼睛也好似毒蛇森冷的眸子，一路上不苟言笑。面对那警察局局长和教育局的刘主任，这名武者只是时而淡然点点头，根本懒得理会。
“在不远的将来，我也会获得武者称号！”罗峰心中默默道。
“卡卡～～～”
第一高中的大门缓缓
“进场了。”立即传来一阵阵声音。
“小峰，进场了。你快进去吧。”父亲罗洪国连道，旁边母亲龚心兰也连道：“快去吧，妈等会儿就回去给你烧饭，你爸和弟弟在这等你考完。”
“嗯。”
罗峰微笑点点头。
“哥。”弟弟罗华坐在轮椅上，向罗峰竖起了自己的拳头，微微一笑，“一定要加油啊！”
“加油。”罗峰也竖起拳头。
随即罗峰转头在考生人群当中一起，经过检查，一一通过了校门口。
※※※※※※
考场教室内，考试证和身份证放在桌子右上角供考官检查，而试卷则开始发了下来。
“2056年江南市高考理科试卷a卷”――试卷的最上面清楚的一行字。
“第一场是理科考试！”

看着面前的试卷，罗峰目光一扫，又看了看最后的几条大题目，似乎是曾相识，“这次题目应该不算难，题目不难的话。我理科的优势就很难发挥出来，只能小心认真的做题，尽量做到会做的不丢分。”
罗峰当即开始埋头去写。
高考一共有三场考试，分别是理科考试、文科考试以及最后的数学考试。每门满分都是250分，总分满分是750分。
理科是指物理、化学、生物三门综合。
文科是值语文、历史、政治、地理四门综合。
数学考试，自然就是数学一门。
人类大涅盘时期之后，特别是人类和怪兽的战斗持续不断，让人类拼命在科技、武道上研究。这令大家更加清晰的感觉到‘数学’的重要。任何一个想要在计算机、生物、物理等领域要获得大成就的，都需要坚实的数学基础。
所以――
文化教育中，数学的地位被提的很高。而罗峰在文科上薄弱一点，而在数学上优势极大。
※※※※※※
六月七号，理科考试。
六月八号，文科考试。
转眼，已经是六月九号。
考场内，数学试卷刚刚发放下来。
“就这一场数学考试了。”罗峰深吸一口气，“理科试卷不难，不过我考的应该不错。文科考试我也正常发挥！也就是说，理科文科两场考试，成绩应该都在我正常发挥范围内。数学考试，只要发挥不失常太多，绝对能进江南第一军校。”
“努力！”
给自己鼓鼓劲，罗峰开始低头做题。
整个考场一片安静，不少考生的眉头都皱了起来，显然题目比较难。每年的高考，数学题一般难度都不低。毕竟这是为了选拔将来的科技研究人才。
“还真够难的。”罗峰也感到了题目的难度，“比往年还要难！不过……越难越好！”
题目简单，数学比自己差的，可能也能考220分，自己估计也就230分。优势很小。

可如果题目难。
自己或许只能考210分，可是比自己差的，或许只靠150分。这样优势反而很大。
“啪！”只听到一声脆响。
考场监考老师立即看去，只见一名考生竟然硬生生折断了手中圆珠笔，这名考生皱着眉咬着牙，低头死死盯着试卷，显然数学难题太难太难。而后这名考生将手中断臂扔到一旁，又取出另外一支圆珠笔，继续答卷。
“看考生的样子，今年这场数学考试，很难啊。”监考老师心中暗想道。
的确，整个考场几乎每一个人都皱眉苦苦思索，不少考生急得眼泪都掉了下来。
数学基础本来就差的学生，只感觉……这条题不会，那条题也不会，第三条题还不会……看到这样的试卷，那些考生几乎要崩溃掉了。
※※※※※※
一个小时之后，考场内。
数学考试时间一共是两个半小时。
此刻罗峰已经写完了‘选择题’和‘填空题’，就剩下‘计算题’了。数学试卷中，选择题和填空题加起来的总分数，也就90分。而计算题则是五条大题目。五道题的分数就是160分，毕竟只有大的计算题，才能更好得发现学生的数学能力。
“还真难，填空题我都有两个空档算不出。”罗峰深吸一口气，“下面是计算题，这才是拿分的重点。多写出一题，就是三十分，四十分的差距！”
计算题五大题，其中前四题都是30分分值，最后一题为40分。
“嗯？”罗峰在计算题第一题面前，就遇到了难关。
在草纸上，罗峰不断计算思考。
“对，这里稍微变形一下，逆退过来，不就能转换成所需要的方程式了嘛？”罗峰眼睛一亮，刷！刷！刷！这难点一想破，写起来就容易的很，酣畅淋漓的一口气将第一题完全写出来，又仔细检查一遍。
“嗯，第一道题成功。”罗峰看了看左手手腕上的手表，心中一跳，“第一条题，就花费我20分钟？必须加快时间了。”
罗峰低头又看第二道题。
乍一看，罗峰感觉容易，立即在草纸上演算。
“嗯，不对。”

罗峰发觉自己想的路子根本不通，立即皱眉思考起来，随着时间的流逝，罗峰不断深入去研究这一题，“对，应该是这样。不过下一个证明，该怎么验证？”罗峰这时候的脑子不断急速思考着。
“快，快，快，在这题上不能浪费太多时间。到底怎么证明？”罗峰心中焦急。
这时候――
罗峰左手戴着的手表上，显示‘脉搏’的数字开始上升。
120……125……130……140……150……
“就差一点，这一题的命题就能证明了，30分就到手了。这里到底该该怎么弄？”罗峰愈加急躁，考试是必须分配时间的，可是数学题的计算题，每一题分值很大。每一个高考考生，想要考试成绩很好，数学的大题目，不能错太多。
这时候，注意力完全沉浸在考试题目中的罗峰，根本没注意手表上的脉搏显示。
160……170……180……
罗峰感觉到心跳加速，可是他只当是考试时候的焦急紧张导致的，并没在意。
“咚！咚！咚！”罗峰忽然觉得自己的心脏就好像被人敲击一样，眼睛都是一阵发话，这才惊醒，“我怎么了？心跳怎么这么难受。”罗峰低头看了看手表上测试脉搏的显示读数――
230！
这个数字，让罗峰脸色大变。自从十二岁那年昏迷之后，买了这手表，罗峰就从来没看过自己的心跳超过180.
“好难受。”罗峰感到心跳仿佛要从胸腔里跳出来，全身的血液在动力源‘心脏’不断膨胀收缩下，大量的鲜血涌动，一道道无形不可察的能量涌入罗峰的脑海深处，顿时，一阵剧痛从脑海中传来――
“啊，啊。”罗峰忍不住发出声音。
“这位考生，你怎么了？”监考老师连赶过来，他震惊的看着罗峰。
此刻的罗峰，面色涨红，仿佛要滴血一般，额头、手臂上的青筋暴突，而且还一跳一跳的，整个人狰狞的很。
“不，不――不要，减慢，减慢啊。”罗峰预感到不妙，心中怒吼着，双眼死死盯着手表。
“236……242……251……！”
咚！咚！咚！
心脏就仿佛一个大鼓，发出一阵阵低沉轰鸣声，血液迅速涌动。

随着双眼模糊的看到‘268’的数字，头脑中的剧痛令罗峰整个人瞬间昏迷，昏迷的时候，隐隐约约听到了那道声音――
“这位考生，这位考生，醒醒，醒醒。快，快叫救护车！”。
content_en:
Call for recommendation votes,
One month before the college entrance examination, Luo Feng devoted almost all his energy to reviewing. As the review progressed and he took mock tests again and again, Luo Feng became more and more confident in the college entrance examination!
"Take the exam at the Jiangnan First Military Academy, and you're a sure shot."
This is what Luo Feng is thinking.
※※※※※※
June 7th is the first day of the college entrance examination. The college entrance examination in Huaxia Kingdom is held for three days on June 7th, which is the same as the college entrance examination before the Great Nirvana period.
The first high school in Yi'an District.
According to the examination room arrangement, Luo Feng, who was originally a student of No. 3 Middle School, took the college entrance examination at No. 1 High School.
"Daughter, come on."
"Don't worry, Dad."
"Tiantian, don't put too much pressure on yourself."
Outside the gate of No. 1 High School, a large number of college entrance examination candidates and parents gathered. And outside the gate of No. 1 High School, there was also a row of police officers holding live ammunition.
"Xiao Feng, you should relax during the exam. Even if our family can't go to the First Military Academy, we can go to the Second Military Academy. Just relax!" Father Luo Hongguo looked at his son and said with a smile.
"Yeah." Luo Feng smiled and nodded.
"Beep - beep -" With the loud honking of the car, I saw a dark, latest Mercedes-Benz S600 full of aristocratic temperament, slowly driving towards the gate of the No. 1 High School, escorted by police motorcycles. The parents of the surrounding candidates immediately moved aside, and all their eyes were focused on the car.
The latest Mercedes-Benz S600 accelerates to a speed of 100 kilometers per hour in only one second and six, and the top speed reaches 500 kilometers per hour. Of course, this performance is nothing. As a brand passed down from the Great Nirvana period, the Mercedes-Benz S600's own historical heritage is the most attractive.
I saw three people getting out of the Mercedes-Benz S600, talking and laughing with each other and walking towards the school gate.
"The bald man on the left is Director Zhang of the Yi'an District Police Department."
"The one on the right is Director Liu from the Education Bureau."
"The one in the middle must be the warrior who is in charge of the safety of the examination room." A large number of parents and candidates were seen talking about it outside the examination room. Most people's eyes were focused on the person in the middle, with excitement, admiration, and curiosity in their eyes.
Nowadays, the battle between humans and monsters is ongoing.
Ordinary people are prohibited from leaving the city limits, but warriors are the ones who can fight monsters one-on-one. The entire human society is also very grateful to the warriors for their great contributions to mankind. Ordinary people naturally admire warriors.
Warriors belong to a group of people with a transcendent status in the human community.
"That's the warrior." His father, Luo Hongguo, also looked at that person. "Every time the college entrance examination is conducted, a warrior is appointed as the overall security commander."
"Warrior."
Luo Feng looked over and saw that the warrior had a feeling that made people feel palpitated just by looking at him. His eyes were like the cold eyes of a poisonous snake, and he was unsmiling all the way. Facing the police chief and Director Liu of the Education Bureau, the warrior just nodded indifferently from time to time and didn't bother to pay attention.
"In the near future, I will also receive the title of warrior!" Luo Feng said silently in his heart.
"Kaka~~~"
The door of No. 1 High School slowly opens
"Coming in." There were sounds immediately.
"Xiao Feng, it's time to enter. Come in quickly," his father Luo Hongguo said, and his mother Gong Xinlan said next to him, "Go quickly. Mom will go back and cook for you later. Your father and brother are here waiting for you to finish the exam."
"Yeah."
Luo Feng smiled and nodded.
"Brother." His younger brother Luo Hua sat in a wheelchair, raised his fist to Luo Feng, and smiled slightly, "You must work hard!"
"Come on." Luo Feng also raised his fist.
Luo Feng then turned around and joined the crowd of candidates. After inspection, they passed through the school gate one by one.
※※※※※※
In the examination room classroom, examination certificate andThe ID card was placed in the upper right corner of the table for the examiner to check, and the test papers began to be handed out.
"2056 Jiangnan City College Entrance Examination Science Test Paper A" - the clear line at the top of the test paper.
"The first test is the science exam!"
Looking at the test paper in front of him, Luo Feng glanced at the last few big questions and looked at them as if he had known each other before. "The questions this time should not be difficult. If the questions are not difficult, it will be difficult for me to give full play to my advantages in science. I can only do the questions carefully and conscientiously, and try my best to do it as well as possible without losing points."
Luo Feng immediately began to immerse himself in writing.
There are three examinations in the college entrance examination, namely science examination, liberal arts examination and the final mathematics examination. The full score for each subject is 250 points, and the total score is 750 points.
Science refers to the combination of physics, chemistry and biology.
Liberal arts is a comprehensive study of four subjects: Chinese, history, politics, and geography.
The mathematics test is naturally mathematics.
After the Great Nirvana period of mankind, especially the continuous battle between humans and monsters, humans desperately researched in technology and martial arts. This makes everyone feel more clearly the importance of ‘mathematics’. Anyone who wants to achieve great achievements in the fields of computers, biology, physics, etc. needs a solid mathematical foundation.
So——
In cultural education, the status of mathematics has been raised very high. Luo Feng is weaker in liberal arts, but has a huge advantage in mathematics.
※※※※※※
June 7th, science exam.
June 8th, liberal arts exam.
In a blink of an eye, it’s already June 9th.
In the examination room, the mathematics test papers have just been distributed.
"This is the math test." Luo Feng took a deep breath. "The science test paper is not difficult, but I should do well in the test. I also performed normally in the liberal arts test! In other words, the results in the two science and liberal arts tests should be within my normal range. In the math test, as long as I don't perform too abnormally, I can definitely get into Jiangnan First Military Academy."
"Work hard!"
To encourage himself, Luo Feng lowered his head and began to answer the questions.
The entire examination room was quiet, and many candidates frowned. It was obvious that the questions were difficult. In the college entrance examination every year, the mathematics questions are generally very difficult. After all, this is to select future scientific and technological research talents.
"It's really difficult." Luo Feng also felt the difficulty of the question, "It's even more difficult than in previous years! But... the harder, the better!"
The questions are simple and those who are worse than me in mathematics may be able to get 220 points, but I estimate that I will only get 230 points. The advantage is small.
But if the question is difficult.
You may only be able to score 210 points, but those who are worse than you may only be able to score 150 points. This advantage is actually huge.
"Bang!" Only a crisp sound was heard.
The invigilator in the examination room immediately looked around and saw that one candidate broke the ballpoint pen in his hand. The candidate frowned and gritted his teeth, lowering his head and staring at the test paper. It was obvious that the math problem was too difficult. Then the candidate threw his broken arm aside, took out another ballpoint pen, and continued to answer the question.
"Looking at the candidates, this year's math test is going to be very difficult." The invigilator thought to himself.
Indeed, almost everyone in the entire examination room frowned and thought hard, and many candidates were so anxious that they shed tears.
Students with poor mathematical foundations just feel that... they don't know this question, they don't know that question, they don't know the third question... Seeing such a test paper, those candidates almost collapsed.
※※※※※※
An hour later, in the examination room.
The total math test time is two and a half hours.
At this moment, Luo Feng has finished writing the 'choice questions' and 'fill-in-the-blank questions', and only the 'calculation questions' are left. In the mathematics test paper, the total score of multiple choice questions and fill-in-the-blank questions is 90 points. The calculation questions are five major questions. The score for five questions is 160 points. After all, only large calculation questions can better discover students' mathematical abilities.
“It’s really difficult. I have two fill-in-the-blank questions.The gap cannot be calculated. Luo Feng took a deep breath, "The following are calculation questions. This is the key point to get points." Writing one more question is the difference between thirty and forty points! "
There are five major calculation questions, the first four of which are worth 30 points, and the last question is worth 40 points.
"Huh? "Luo Feng encountered difficulties when facing the first calculation question.
On the papyrus paper, Luo Feng kept calculating and thinking.
"Yes, wouldn't it be possible to convert it into the required equation by deforming it slightly and going backwards? "Luo Feng's eyes lit up, brush! brush! brush! Once this difficulty was solved, writing became very easy. He wrote out the first question completely in one hearty breath and checked it again carefully.
"Well, the first question was successful. Luo Feng looked at the watch on his left wrist and his heart skipped a beat, "The first question only took me 20 minutes?" Time must be sped up. "
Luo Feng lowered his head and looked at the second question.
At first glance, Luo Feng thought it was easy and immediately calculated on the straw paper.
"Well, no. "
Luo Feng realized that the path he was thinking of didn't make sense at all, and immediately frowned and started thinking. As time passed, Luo Feng continued to study this question in depth, "Yes, that should be the case. But how to verify the next proof? "Luo Feng's mind was thinking rapidly at this time.
"Quick, quick, quick, don't waste too much time on this question. How to prove it? "Luo Feng was anxious.
At this time——
On the watch worn on Luo Feng's left hand, the number showing 'pulse' began to rise.
120…125…130…140…150…
"Just a little bit, the proposition of this question can be proved, and you can get it in 30 points. What should we do here? " Luo Feng became more and more impatient. Time must be allocated for exams, but calculation questions in mathematics are worth a lot of points. Every college entrance examination candidate wants to get good scores in the exam, so he cannot make too many mistakes in big mathematics questions.
At this time, Luo Feng, who was completely immersed in the exam questions, didn't pay attention to the pulse display on his watch.
160…170…180…
Luo Feng felt his heartbeat speed up, but he just thought it was caused by anxiety and nervousness during the exam and didn't pay attention.
“Boom! Boom! Boom! "Luo Feng suddenly felt as if his heart was being knocked by someone, and his eyes were talking for a while, and then he woke up, "What's wrong with me? Why is my heartbeat so uncomfortable? "Luo Feng lowered his head and looked at the pulse test reading on his watch -
230!
This number made Luo Feng's expression change greatly. Ever since he bought this watch after falling into a coma at the age of twelve, Luo Feng had never seen his heartbeat exceed 180.
“It’s so uncomfortable. "Luo Feng felt as if his heartbeat was about to jump out of his chest. The blood in his body was constantly expanding and contracting as the power source 'heart' continued to expand and contract. A large amount of blood surged, and invisible and undetectable energy poured into the depths of Luo Feng's mind. Suddenly, a sharp pain came from his mind -
"Ah, ah. "Luo Feng couldn't help but make a sound.
"This candidate, what's wrong with you? "The invigilator rushed over and looked at Luo Feng in shock.
At this moment, Luo Feng's face was red, as if he was about to bleed. The veins on his forehead and arms were popping out, and they were jumping up and down. He looked very ferocious.
"No, no - don't, slow down, slow down. "Luo Feng had a premonition that something was not going to happen, and he roared in his heart, staring at his watch.
“236…242…251…! "
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The heart is like a big drum, making low roaring sounds, and the blood surges rapidly.
As his eyes blurred to see the number '268', the severe pain in his head caused Luo Feng to faint instantly. When he was unconscious, he vaguely heard the voice——
“This candidate, this candidate, wake up, wake up. Quick, call an ambulance! ".
